{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Destination: Adventure!''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] docked at the ''Adventure!'' after taking on the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] at the behest of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Mal Biron]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the liner was the site of a [[Battle of the Destination: Adventure!|space battle]] between [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
